  - High school diploma minimum; many prefer an associate’s degree or college coursework in IT/IS [3][4][5]
  - A+ certification (often listed as “strongly preferred” or a bonus) [3][4][5]

- **Work environment**
  - Mostly office‑based or remote with occasional on‑site days (e.g., 3 days/month) [2]
  - Full‑time schedule, often 8 am‑4 pm or similar [1][5]
